resolution.summary: The stipulation records that the committee filed amendments disclosing the missing information after the elections and after notice of the investigation, and that the penalty was agreed in an early settlement.

citations.quote: Additionally, although Respondents voluntarily filed amendments disclosing the missing subvendor information, the information was not disclosed until after the relevant elections and only after notification that an investigation had been initiated.
Respondents cooperated with the Enforcement Division of the Fair Political Practices Commission by agreeing to an early settlement of this matter

items.summary: In a stipulation with the Fair Political Practices Commission, Grove, her 2010 Assembly committee and its treasurer agreed that they failed to timely report subvendor information for payments of about $229,374 on 2010 primary campaign statements, and agreed to a $2,250 administrative penalty.
items.title: FPPC stipulated penalty for late subvendor reporting by her 2010 Assembly committee

citations.quote: Count 1: Respondents Shannon Grove, Shannon Grove for Assembly 2010, and Karen Cain failed to timely report subvendor information for payments totaling approximately $229,374 on campaign statements filed in connection with the 2010 Primary Election, in violation of Sections 84211, subdivision (k), and 84303.
Respondents also agree to the Commission imposing upon them an administrative penalty in the amount of $2,250.

items.summary: The FPPC Enforcement Division found that Grove did not file a behested payment report (Form 803) within 30 days of a December 9, 2021 payment of $5,000 or more to CityServe, and closed the case with a warning letter rather than a fine, citing mitigating factors.
items.title: FPPC warning letter for a late behested payment report

citations.quote: Specifically, we found that on December 9, 2021, a payment of $5,000 or more was made to CityServe at your behest.
Your actions violated the Act because you failed to timely file a Form 803 within 30 days of the date of the payment.
the Enforcement Division has decided to close this case with this warning letter rather than issue a fine
